* Script `QIF_AD_invasive_macro_time_series.m` loads  Invasive QIF AD parameter inference results `optimization_results`, estimate median for each size of the network and uses that results to generate time series of reconstructed system.

* `QIF_AD_invasive_spectra_comparisson.m` loads time series generated by `QIF_AD_invasive_macro_time_series.m` estimates its spectral dencity and compares it with power spectra generated by control free newtorks with true parameters. Due to size limits, time series of free system are not reuploaded here. Please copy it from `QIF_AD/Noninvasive/time_series` folder.
